# Midstream Energy Industry and Inflation Update

Report 133 | Published 2024-03-31 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-3-31/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/133.json)

Fiscal inflation and self-financed midstream value.

This report should not yield a single inflation accuracy mark: stickiness, a renewed wave and a decade-average regime are different propositions. EPD distribution growth is verifiable; equity return arithmetic is conditional. Rent stabilization met adverse evidence.

**Coverage:** Full source read, including retrospective inflation discussion, bitcoin indicators and MLP structure. Prior quoted calls are treated as history rather than new forecasts.

### 133-C24

**Bitcoin should outpace gold.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Not testable |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Next few years |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | bitcoin-over-gold |
| Source blocks | 151 |
| Thesis family | bitcoin-over-gold |

The unspecified length of next few years prevents a unique terminal verdict. The disclosed cutoff sensitivity is strongly adverse: bitcoin +8.67% versus GLD +79.25%, a 70.58-point shortfall from April 1 2024. Positive bitcoin direction would conceal this relative miss. GLD is an investable gold proxy with its own fee drag.

**Direction:** No exact resolution rule; disclosed sensitivity only.

**Timing:** Next few years

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Retain explicit sensitivity windows; do not invent an author deadline.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [BTC-USD adjusted-close sensitivity](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BTC-USD/history/) | Yahoo Finance | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Observed window: 2024-04-01 to 2026-11-06. Requested endpoint: 2026-11-07.

| Instrument | Entry adjusted price | Exit adjusted price | Return (%) | Annualized (%) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BTC-USD | 69,702.15 | 75,746.93 | 8.67 | 3.25 |
| GLD | 207.82 | 372.52 | 79.25 | 25.18 |

First common trading close strictly after publication to last common close on/before the disclosed endpoint. Adjusted close as vendor dividend/split-adjusted proxy; USD listings; no taxes, fees or portfolio exits. Not a reconstructed subscriber trade.
